realPairedReplay.protocol: Fresh Node process for every version/round; paired serial workers with alternating baseline/optimized order. Entire frozen finite sparse observations, fixed K, sigma=1px, Huber=3px, auto solver, one permitted joint iteration, camera budget 1536. No RGB rematching, observation pruning, gate changes or covariance approximation.
realPairedReplay.timingMeaning: Worker elapsedMs covers the solver only, after explicit GC. maxRSS covers the whole worker including module/parse/full-value extraction. These are fresh-process samples, not steady-state/UI/hardware-GPU throughput.
realPairedReplay.provenance: Already-triangulated sparse exports and synthetic supplied correspondences. No source RGB/Dense MVS/ground-truth accuracy comparison. Only summary.json is suitable for repository publication; *.private.json contain map geometry.

checks.scope: Current performance code; previous 244-case full TypeShade suite/website checks are recorded separately and were not rerun for this host-math-only refinement.

backend: Performance measures CPU solver with host f64. WebGPU validation uses Google SwiftShader software adapter; no hardware GPU/UI throughput claim.
limitations: Five fresh-process paired rounds per case; report median/range, not guaranteed throughput.
